summary.text: Lon Pishny is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 122 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Lon Pishny earned bachelor's and graduate degrees from Fort Hays State University, and his career experience includes working as a financial advisor/counselor.
He previously served as a member of the Finney County Commission.
Pishny took office representing Kansas House District 122 on January 13, 2025, succeeding Bill Clifford.
In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the House Education Committee, the House Local Government Committee and the Water Committee.
